name: US Capitol
description: The United States Capitol Building is the seat of the United States Congress and is located in Washington, District of Columbia (Washington.D.C), the capital of the United States. Americans call the Capitol the Capitol and regard it as the highest symbol of political power owned by the people, governed by the people, and for the people. The cornerstone of the Capitol was laid by President Washington himself on September 18, 1793, and it was put into use in 1800. It was burned by the British during the second American-British War in 1814, and some buildings were destroyed. Later, the conference rooms of the House of Representatives and the Senate, the dome and the rotunda were added, and they were remodeled and expanded many times.
